compounds.name: T0901317
compounds.mechanism_nl: Synthetic hexafluoroisopropanol sulfonamide LXRα/β agonist (EC50 ~ 20 nM). Binds directly to the ligand-binding domain of NR1H3 (MIE 167) and forces massive de novo lipogenesis.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Both Graphormer and ToxTransformer see: 'MIE 167 = YES'. Yet at 0.1 µM, PPARA/CPT1A still buffers this homeostatically in the hepatocyte, whereas tipping into steatosis only occurs above ~5-10 µM!

compounds.name: GW3965
compounds.mechanism_nl: Selective non-steroidal LXRα/β agonist with a bistrifluoromethyl-carbinol pharmacophore. Second gold-standard MIE 167 reference inducer for AOP 34 hepatic steatosis.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Although GW3965 potently triggers MIE 167, actual lipid accumulation depends on VLDL export capacity (MTTP/APOB) and exposure duration in the Neural ODE.

compounds.name: Amiodarone
compounds.mechanism_nl: Amphiphilic iodinated benzofuran antiarrhythmic. Induces severe clinical steatohepatitis through simultaneous upregulation of LXR/SREBP-1c lipogenic genes and inhibition of CPT1A.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: At low therapeutic levels, sometimes causes reversible phospholipidosis, but tips into irreversible NASH and apoptosis (CASP3) upon chronic accumulation.

compounds.name: Tamoxifen
compounds.mechanism_nl: Triphenylethylene derivative that stimulates de novo fatty acid synthesis (FASN, ACACA) and fatty acid uptake (CD36) in human hepatocytes (HepaRG), clinically known for drug-induced fatty liver.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: The tipping point toward steatosis only occurs once the compensatory PPARα pathway becomes overloaded.

compounds.name: Bosentan
compounds.mechanism_nl: Endothelin receptor antagonist and archetypal BSEP inhibitor (IC50 ~ 15-25 µM, Rodrigues et al., 2018). Blocks canalicular bile salt export (ABCB11, MIE 41), leading to toxic bile acid retention.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: At low doses, the hepatocyte compensates via FXR (NR1H4): CYP7A1 and SLC10A1 are repressed. Both Graphormer and ToxTransformer lack this intracellular FXR feedback network!

compounds.name: Troglitazone
compounds.mechanism_nl: Withdrawn thiazolidinedione with a chromane ring. Potent competitive inhibitor of BSEP (ABCB11, MIE 41, IC50 ~ 3 µM), resulting in cholestatic liver injury and mitochondrial ROS.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Without time-dependent ODE integration, it is impossible to see how rapidly the Nrf2 (NFE2L2) antioxidant buffer is depleted toward Caspase-3 apoptosis.

compounds.name: Glibenclamide
compounds.mechanism_nl: Sulfonylurea derivative that directly inhibits the ATP-dependent bile salt export pump BSEP (ABCB11, MIE 41) and causes acute bile acid retention in human hepatocytes.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: In vitro, BSEP inhibition occurs at high micromolar concentrations; at low therapeutic doses, the cell remains within the homeostatic FXR attractor.

compounds.name: Chlorpromazine
compounds.mechanism_nl: Classic tricyclic phenothiazine that causes intrahepatic cholestasis by inhibiting BSEP expression/function (MIE 41) combined with oxidative stress and NF-κB inflammatory responses.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: The transition from adaptive cholestatic stress to actual cell death requires modeling the NFKB1 → TP53 → CASP3 cascade in Milestones 1–3.

compounds.name: Fenofibrate
compounds.mechanism_nl: Clinical lipid-lowering drug that activates PPAR-alpha (PPARA). Stimulates mitochondrial β-oxidation (CPT1A) and VLDL export (MTTP/APOB) and inhibits SREBP-1c (reinforces the healthy attractor z0!).
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Crucial test compound: contains aromatic rings and halogen like many drugs, yet triggers neither MIE 167 nor MIE 41 and instead stabilizes the homeostatic attractor.

compounds.name: DMSO_Control
compounds.mechanism_nl: Dimethyl sulfoxide: standard solvent and negative control in HepaRG toxicity experiments. Neither triggers LXRα (MIE 167) nor inhibits BSEP (MIE 41).
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Serves in Milestones 1–4 as the zero anchor point where dz/dt = 0 remains at the healthy attractor z0.

compounds.name: Caffeine
compounds.mechanism_nl: Xanthine alkaloid and standard negative control in DILI benchmarks. Smoothly metabolized by hepatocytes without disrupting lipid or bile acid homeostasis.
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Confirms that heterocyclic small molecules lacking an MIE pharmacophore score low on both MIE 167 and MIE 41.

compounds.name: Metformin
compounds.mechanism_nl: First-line biguanide antidiabetic. Activates AMPK, thereby inhibiting ACACA and SREBF1; causes neither steatosis (MIE 167) nor BSEP cholestasis (MIE 41).
compounds.limitation_note_nl: Demonstrates that hydrophilic metabolic modulators are clearly separated from lipophilic LXR/BSEP ligands.

validation.protocol: leave-one-out cross-validation (12 folds; nearest class prototype in the frozen foundation embedding space: 768D Graphormer [CLS] and 524D ToxTransformer representation)
validation.in_sample_note: In-sample accuracy is not reported: the MIE heads are calibrated on all 12 reference compounds (250 epochs), so a perfect training diagonal is guaranteed by construction.
